summary: Iteration 9 - Verified all NurseConnect WF8 workflow enhancements. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_workflow_wf8.py (15 new API contract tests) covering: Select gating (400 without completed interview, 400 without joining_date, 200 with both), Interview->completed cascade to application interview_completed, Nurse-only-withdraw restriction (403 on any other field/status), Mark Joined transition, /candidate-documents privacy (own hospital OK, other hospital 403), /candidate-notes privacy (owner OK, other hospital 403 GET+POST, nurse cannot see note text via /api/application list or detail), and hospital<->hospital RLS on application read/patch. Full backend suite: 87/87 pass (72 preexisting + 15 new) after fixing one iteration_8 test whose old contract predated the new joining_date requirement (updated to send joining_date). Frontend smoke: nurse signup + login through UI succeeds; /nurse/dashboard has nurse-verification-banner + dashboard-verification-badge + dashboard-notifications-card; /nurse/jobs shows profile-incomplete-banner with complete-profile-cta and a top yellow warning banner 'Complete your profile to apply...' rather than allowing Apply; /nurse/interviews renders 'Previous Interviews' section; /nurse/profile has documents-save-btn; Hospital nav item labeled 'Applications' at route /hospital/candidates. All required data-testids in Candidates.jsx (select-btn-<id>, joining-date-dialog, joining-date-input, confirm-select-btn, mark-joined-btn-<id>, candidate-doc-download-<id>, candidate-note-input, candidate-note-save-btn) and Applications.jsx (withdraw-application-btn-<id>, congratulations-dialog, congrats-joining-date) are present in source. No blocking issues found.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:548-553 correctly gates PATCH status=selected on BOTH a completed interview record AND a joining_date -> HTTP 400 otherwise. Verified via direct API bypassing UI.
server.py:541-547 nurse-only-withdraw rule is tight: any non-{status,updated_at} key OR status!=withdrawn -> 403. Confirmed.
server.py:574-577 interview status=completed cascades application to interview_completed only if app is in an earlier state; keeps idempotency safe. Good.
server.py:411-419 /candidate-documents restricts to hospital owner of the linked job (403 otherwise). Confirmed.

server.py:422-446 /candidate-notes: notes stored in a SEPARATE collection (candidate_notes) so the generic /api/application response never leaks them - verified nurse GET does not contain note text. Good separation of concerns.
server.py:429 GET returns default {application_id, note: ''} when no note exists - avoids null-handling on FE.
Candidates.jsx select-btn is only rendered when application status == interview_completed; joining-date-dialog with joining-date-input + confirm-select-btn is wired correctly with min=today.
match.js isProfileComplete requires full_name+phone+city+qualification+experience_years+departments as specified; Jobs.jsx uses it to render profile-incomplete-banner and block Apply.
